title: Contributing to containr
text: containr wraps system commands (podman, docker) tested end--end without running container daemon, real images, , push_image(), live registry. test suite addresses three-layer strategy. Layer 1 – Argument validation. Pure R checks bad arguments error correctly required arguments enforced. tests run every platform, including CRAN, external dependencies. text: generate_dockerfile() reads renv.lock, infers system library requirements R packages, writes Dockerfile project root. entry point containr workflow step work behalf. r_version argument match R version recorded renv.lock. Using consistent R version lockfile base image reduces chance package installation failures inside container. comments = TRUE argument annotates instruction generated Dockerfile explanation . useful learning containerization reviewing file collaborators. generated Dockerfile looks like comments enabled: Dockerfile plain text file. can inspect , edit , regenerate many times needed. project unusual system library requirements generate_dockerfile() catch, add install_syslibs argument: project uses RStudio Server rather plain R, pass r_mode = "rstudio" use rocker/rstudio base image instead: Take minutes read generated Dockerfile moving . Understanding makes subsequent steps easier reason debug something goes wrong.
code: generate_dockerfile(   r_version = "4.4.0",   output    = ".",   comments  = TRUE ) # Base image: rocker/r-ver provides a minimal R installation on Ubuntu. # Pinning the R version ensures the container matches your renv.lock. FROM rocker/r-ver:4.4.0  # Suppress interactive prompts during apt-get package installation. ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive  # Install system libraries required by your R packages. # These are inferred from the packages recorded in renv.lock. RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \     curl \     git \     libcurl4-openssl-dev \     libssl-dev \     libxml2-dev \     libgit2-dev \     cmake \     make \     libfreetype6-dev \     libjpeg-dev \     libpng-dev \     libtiff-dev \     libfontconfig1-dev \     libfribidi-dev \     libharfbuzz-dev \     pandoc \     && apt-get clean \     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*  # Set the working directory inside the container. WORKDIR /home  # Copy renv.lock into the container so renv can restore the R package # environment at build time. COPY renv.lock /home/renv.lock  # Install renv from CRAN, then restore the R package environment from # renv.lock. This step reproduces your exact package versions inside # the container. RUN R -e "install.packages('renv', repos='https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/latest')" RUN R -e "renv::restore()" generate_dockerfile(   r_version       = "4.4.0",   output          = ".",   install_syslibs = c("libuv1-dev", "libwebp-dev") ) generate_dockerfile(   r_version = "4.4.0",   r_mode    = "rstudio",   output    = "." )

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Requires renv.lock in the current working directory. # Run renv::snapshot() first if you don't have one.  # Generate a minimal Dockerfile using a pinned R version generate_dockerfile(r_version = "4.4.0", output = tempdir())  # Pin a specific R version with the tidyverse image generate_dockerfile(r_version = "4.3.0", r_mode = "tidyverse",                     output = tempdir())  # Add extra system libraries on top of auto-detected ones generate_dockerfile(   r_version       = "4.4.0",   install_syslibs = c("libuv1-dev", "libwebp-dev"),   output          = "." )  # Include a data file and annotate the Dockerfile with comments generate_dockerfile(   r_version = "4.3.0",   data_file = "data/penguins.csv",   comments  = TRUE,   output    = "." ) } # }

title: Tag and push a container image to a registry — push_image
text: image_id character string. local image ID name push, shown podman image ls docker image ls. typically 12-character hash (e.g. "974123909a36") locally assigned name image built tag via build_image(). netid character string. UW-Madison NetID, used construct full registry path, e.g. "erwin.lares". project character string. GitLab project name hosts container registry, e.g. "container-registry". tag character string. version tag assign image. Defaults "latest". Using explicit version tags (e.g. "1.0.0") recommended reproducibility — "latest" overwritten every push. registry character string. registry hostname. Defaults "registry.doit.wisc.edu" (UW-Madison CHTC). tool character string NULL. container tool use. One "podman" "docker". NULL (default), function auto-detects tool available, preferring podman. check_login Logical. TRUE (default), verifies logged registry attempting push. logged , function errors instructions authenticate. dry_run Logical. TRUE, prints commands run without executing . Defaults FALSE. verbose Logical. TRUE, prints progress messages step. Defaults FALSE. comments Logical. TRUE, prints explanatory context step — command , needed, common pitfalls. Useful first-time users learning container push workflow. Defaults FALSE.

title: Tag and push a container image to a registry — push_image
text: GitLab container registry requires authentication pushing. Use Personal Access Token (PAT) rather NetID password — PATs can scoped registry access revoked independently. Authentication cached podman docker first login, need run podman login per machine per session. Note GitLab Self-Managed authentication tokens expire five minutes default. see unauthorized: authentication required error mid-push large image, re-authenticate push .

title: containr 0.1.3.9000
text: build_image() builds container image Dockerfile using either podman docker. Auto-detects tool available, preferring podman. Supports dry_run = TRUE preview build command without executing . verbose comments follow contract generate_dockerfile(). push_image() tags locally built container image full registry path pushes container registry single call, handling podman tag podman push steps internally. Arguments: image_id, netid, project, tag (defaults "latest"), registry (defaults "registry.doit.wisc.edu"). Supports login verification, dry_run = TRUE, guided output via verbose comments. list_images() returns data frame container images local image store, reported podman image ls docker image ls. Useful finding image ID pass push_image() building image build_image(). Prints data frame console returns invisibly. Two new internal helpers shared build_image(), push_image(), list_images(): .resolve_tool() auto-detects podman docker PATH, .check_tool_responsive() verifies daemon running attempting build, push, list operation.

title: containr 0.1.3.9000
text: generate_dockerfile() refactored: r_mode validated file network operations, dplyr dependency removed, expose_port now warns r_mode "rstudio", build loop simplified, invisible(NULL) added return value. generate_dockerfile() now requires renv.lock file current working directory. Errors informatively none found, instructions run renv::snapshot(). New auto_syslibs argument (default TRUE) reads renv.lock, queries Posit Package Manager sysreqs database via remotes::system_requirements(), automatically includes system libraries required packages lock file. Warns continues without auto-detection lookup fails. New install_syslibs argument (default NULL) accepts character vector additional apt package names install top auto-detected set, e.g. install_syslibs = c("libuv1-dev", "libwebp-dev"). curl now always installed baseline system package regardless auto_syslibs install_syslibs. required renv package downloads inside container. Breaking change: hardcoded system library list (cmake, libcurl4-openssl-dev, libssl-dev, etc.) removed. Libraries now determined entirely auto_syslibs install_syslibs. old install_syslibs = TRUE argument longer works — pass character vector library names instead. generate_dockerfile() now calls renv::status() defensively warns lock file appears sync project library. success message now reports path Dockerfile written verbose = TRUE.
